scope: Prototype observational rules for a two-lap telemetry comparison. Draft only; not reviewed, not active, and not a performance verdict.

rules.name: Speed comparison is available when both laps align with sufficient coverage

source.document: Telemetry Data Dictionary and Engineering Fundamentals Notes
source.quote: Cross-lap alignment is approximate because racing lines differ.

rules.notes: Availability only. It does not claim that one lap is faster overall.

rules.name: A speed-profile difference is observed when the delta exceeds tolerance

source.document: Telemetry Data Dictionary and Engineering Fundamentals Notes
source.quote: is a change in speed per unit time along the path

rules.notes: Tolerance is a prototype configuration value.

rules.name: A relative brake-onset difference is observed when it exceeds uncertainty

source.document: Telemetry Data Dictionary and Engineering Fundamentals Notes
source.quote: Never describe it as pressure or pedal force.

rules.notes: Brake is an indicator, not pressure.

rules.name: An observed brake-onset difference makes braking dynamics a relevant learning topic

source.document: Telemetry Data Dictionary and Engineering Fundamentals Notes
source.quote: Braking distance grows with the square of entering speed

rules.notes: Topic relevance only; no diagnosis of driver or car.

rules.name: Understeer diagnosis is withheld when steering or vehicle response is unavailable

source.document: Telemetry Data Dictionary and Engineering Fundamentals Notes
source.quote: Any causal explanation of an understeer/oversteer diagnosis

rules.notes: Guardrail: missing data is not negative evidence.

rules.name: Drag comparison is withheld when aerodynamic and power context is unavailable

source.document: Telemetry Data Dictionary and Engineering Fundamentals Notes

rules.notes: Guardrail against estimating drag from speed.

rules.name: Comparison context limitation is flagged when tyre or track context is unavailable

source.document: Telemetry Data Dictionary and Engineering Fundamentals Notes
source.quote: entering speed, tyre history, fuel, wind, traffic and driver intent can all differ

rules.name: Supported engineering interpretation is withheld when scientific evidence is unverified

source.document: Telemetry Data Dictionary and Engineering Fundamentals Notes
source.quote: If a licensed source is not obtained, the claim is recorded as a blocker rather than filled with an invented citation.

rules.notes: Knowledge gate: string verification is not semantic entailment.
